name: Sharp Eye

source.note: Entered from published reviews and guides to Ravenloft: The Horrors Within (and Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft, which it revises); compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Advantage on the checks of your Search and Study actions, a number of times per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

benefits.name: Keen Scrutiny
benefits.summary: PB times per Long Rest, give yourself Advantage on a Search or Study action's check.
benefits.text: When you take the Search or Study action, you can give yourself Advantage on the ability check you make as part of it. You can do this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses on a Long Rest.
